observed: Ask Gemini button, Gemini menu, bottom bar and side panel are enabled for the current account.

Cancel while generating showed Canceled request.

Undo clicked after full reload did not remove the text; undo-before-reload remains untested.
Closing Gemini exposed the collapsed bottom bar.
